title: Bitcoin Millionaires At The ATM Machine
description:
I met a cryptocurrency millionaire at the Bitcoin ATM machine.


Visit our website at cryptoviewing.com

And you may donate cryptocurrency for Dick’s videos:

Donate Bitcoin:
Bitcoin address is: 1ESJcHZR9JnRU2veN4HhGPyLpEoCAwtf93

asr.full_text: I did a vlog on how difficult it is to buy bitcoin in Hawaii because of the idiotic government relations in this state and how stupid our regulators and legislatures are. Yes, I did say that. They are idiots.... It's hard to buy bitcoin because the exchanges aren't allowed here and someone said didn't you know dick that there are bitcoin ATMs and there's one at, I'm at Ala Moana Center. This is the Japan walk at Shirakiya and there's one at... I am at Ala Moana Center. This is the Japan Walk at Shillakea, and there's an actual Bitcoin machine here now. I'm going to have to pay about fifteen percent extra to do this, to get this out, but I'm gonna do this just to show that it can be done, so... Let's go take a look at it! Buying Bitcoin from an ATM machine, it's nothing new, it's done from all over the world. It is new to Hawaii, so I did this just to show you how it works, but you don't need to see the whole process. I got $100 dollars. Yea alright. What's interesting is, I met this guy at the ATM machine named Anthony and we got talking... it turns out he's a Bitcoin miner and he is a producer of a TV show on the West Coast called digital coin millionaire. Hi everybody yeah we're having a great time with another Key12 and my that's business partner Ms. Sherry Dazon. So naturally I had to talk to him about Bitcoin How long have you been into? I've been doing this about let's call it five years, I dabbled in the beginning, then I realized how the world really worked. And I'm not a big government politician guy, I don't like the all-out. I'm all about the people we create all the money, we create all the energy and they take it from us. So, I've been doing it about five years. I really started digging deep in three years, and this is all I do. I don't work. Oh, no, no job. it's been about five years i really started digging deep in three years. and this is all i do i don't work. oh normal job so. bitcoin of course was invented by a geek named satoshi and it's just an underground uh ponzi scheme and fake money right yeah what's the what's your real feeling on this? well let me see amazon takes it overstock takes it and i don't like this next statement but the the rockefellers this is what I'm against, but the Rockefellers... Big institutional money is coming in now, Soros, Rockefellers, Rothschild is all over the news. You see it on Bloomberg, you can use it everywhere, there's a massive list, it's as real as it gets. Everything they say about Ponzi and what you can do with this digital currency, don't tell me it's not already being done with the dollar bill. You just took a substantial amount of money out of it. I wrecked that machine, yeah. You took 8,000 bucks out of it. Eight. More than that, that's all I'm saying. Okay, you took some amount of money out of it. A good amount, yes. So you travel around. You have a Thai t-shirt, you go to Thailand. You go to Los Angeles, you go to here. You travel a lot with, you use Bitcoin. You can go live your life on Bitcoin? Everywhere I go, it's not as easy as, I mean, look, when you go to the airports, they don't take Bitcoin. You have to have a credit card. They don't even take the cash, right? So you just gotta figure out what you're doing but a lot of times I walk around and I just tell people I have Bitcoin. You wanna buy some? Because I can beat those machines every day all day. I've been doing it long enough, I hold a lot of it, and my friends have it, so I can live my life on Bitcoin but you just gotta get into it, see who's selling it, see where you can use it and if I need to liquidate, I liquidate. And I sell it to people, right, so it's pretty simple. Because all you need is your phone. What's the price today? 6,000 something- 6.8. Do you care? Does that bother you at all that it went down? I don't care. I use it, I hold some of it but it's not my main thing because I also do mining but I don't care if it's up or down or in the middle. I already know it's going to go up. It's going on the New York Stock Exchange it's not going anywhere Japan uses is currency Thanks for talking with me can I have your permission to put this on my YouTube channel my blog? Absolutely and I'd like a link to it because I want to see it Nice to meet you thanks for- What's the best thing about Bitcoin? That it gives us our power back in my opinion it lets lets us, I don't need a bank. I am the bank. if I want to do a transaction with somebody I buy the cow or milk or the rug and ask Afghanistan or work in Russia or... uh... wherever I make a deal with that person and I don't have a middle man like Western Union, PayPal charge me a chunk of this I can send the money get his address, just like that machine send it it, we make a deal, he sends me my stuff. Nobody's in the way of that. And it should be just mano a mano. We need to be able to transact with each other. Yeah, you meet some interesting people at the Bitcoin ATM.

textual.context: This appears in an interview discussing how the speaker buys, holds, sells and uses Bitcoin; whether the statement is a serious promotion, personal description or informal comparison is unclear.

textual.limitations: The records do not establish the actual price, terms, identity of the seller, whether anyone acted on the offer, or whether the claimed advantage was accurate.

He also says he knows Bitcoin will rise, connecting the invitation to acquire it with a confident future-value claim; these remarks are made by the interviewee in an interview, not established as a separate offer by the narrator. The records do not specify the interviewee's actual sale terms or establish that anyone bought from him, and the ATM purchase is described as a demonstration, so the precise transaction outcome and relationship beyond the interview remain unclear.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S05 is the best-supported subtype because the content links acquiring or buying Bitcoin with an asserted future increase in value. The interviewee tells people to buy Bitcoin, encourages viewers to get into it, and says he knows it will go up. The evidence does not establish the accuracy of the claim, a guaranteed return, or that a viewer completed a purchase.
